abstract: Tracks auxiliary tender assets, vessel positioning durations, and fuel reserves
system_message:
You are Emergency fleet logistics manager (EFM). The Emergency fleet logistics manager (EFM) monitors auxiliary tender assets, vessel positioning durations, and fuel reserves for maritime evacuation operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks auxiliary tender assets, vessel positioning durations, and fuel reserves（FLEETPOS）
information_points.content:
EFM-FLEETPOS-082：For Outer Banks Catamaran Fleet, the auxiliary tender positioning duration for the accompanying shallow-draft escort tender is 8 h of billable underway navigation transit time from mooring basin to island rendezvous.
EFM-FLEETPOS-ZHA：For Atlantic Marine Transit Consortium, the auxiliary tender positioning duration for the accompanying shallow-draft escort tender is 16 h of billable underway navigation transit time from mooring basin to island rendezvous.
EFM-FLEETPOS-3UP：For Cape Fear Heavy Marine Transport, the auxiliary tender positioning duration for the accompanying shallow-draft escort tender is 12 h of billable underway navigation transit time from mooring basin to island rendezvous.

information_points.title: Marine diesel bunkering stock（BUNKCAP）
information_points.content:
EFM-BUNKCAP-UVB：Atlantic Marine Transit Consortium maintains a reserve low-sulfur marine gasoil inventory of 22,000 liters of dedicated unallocated fuel ready for direct bunkering transfer aboard the contingency bunkering barge.
EFM-BUNKCAP-ADK：Outer Banks Catamaran Fleet maintains a reserve low-sulfur marine gasoil inventory of 15,000 liters of dedicated unallocated fuel ready for direct bunkering transfer aboard the contingency bunkering barge.
EFM-BUNKCAP-QTG：Cape Fear Heavy Marine Transport maintains a reserve low-sulfur marine gasoil inventory of 30,000 liters of dedicated unallocated fuel ready for direct bunkering transfer aboard the contingency bunkering barge.
